items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: His name was Goldberg. And those suits we had then today would sell about three, four, five hundred dollars. I think we got them for about sixty bucks

ctx.x: Well, that's right. You told me you were in touch with tailors. We talked about tailors in one fall. That's right. That's right. You knew them. They were special tailor-made?

That's right. The first one we had made was one of the finest tailors in the state of Texas, possibly in the United States. His name was Goldberg. And those suits we had then today would sell about three, four, five hundred dollars. I think we got them for about sixty bucks, which in those days was a tremendous price.
And your tires and shirts, did they match?
